The '''Hover Lifter Speeder''' was a transport vehicle which saw some use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The speeder was mostly used to transport [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]] on its flatbed, but it could also carry passengers brave enough to stand unharnessed on the platform.

==Behind the scenes==
The Hover Lifter Speeder is a vehicle that was added to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayey online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' during the ''[[Death Troopers]]'' update of [[2009]].
